cell_type.evidence: VK2 E6/E7 (human vaginal epithelial) cells were obtained from ATCC and cultured in a complete Keratinocyte-Serum Free medium supplemented with the human recombinant epidermal growth factor (rEGF), bovine pituitary extract (BPE), and Pen-Strep (GIBCO-BRL 17005-042).
U937 pro-monocytes were obtained from ATCC and cultured in an RPMI 1640 complete medium supplemented with L-glutamine, Fetal Bovine Serum (FBS), and Pen-Strep (GIBCO-11875093).

sample_source.evidence: HCA produced by two platforms, namely Nicotiana-based manufacturing (HCA-N) and mRNA-mediated expression (HCAmrna) in vaginal cells.

sex.evidence: inferred: Sperm cells were isolated from human semen samples of healthy men aged 18–45 years.

species.evidence: HCA was produced in Nicotiana benthamiana (HCA-N) by KBio, Inc. (Owensboro, KY, USA) as previously described.
